name: Villages Nearby
summary: Villages show up far more often in freshly explored land, so a new world gives you neighbours within a short walk.
logoPrompt: A small village house with a wooden door, a glowing window and a bell on a post beside it, standing on a grass block
description: **Villages Nearby makes villages appear more often, so you meet your first neighbours after a short walk instead of a long trek.**
- About 2.4 times as many villages in newly generated land.
- Plains, desert, savanna, snowy and taiga villages keep their usual biomes and chances.
- Villages still keep some distance from each other, so they do not pile up.
Pick the zip under Data Packs when you create a new world, or put it into the `datapacks` folder of an existing world and open the world again. Then explore.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21 and 1.21.1.
- Works on new and existing worlds, but only land generated after the pack is added gets the extra villages. Chunks you have already visited do not change.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. Because it changes world generation, Minecraft may show its "experimental settings" notice when you open the world.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
